# Smart Environment Group

Smart Environment Group provides property development, construction and property services across London, Hertfordshire and the Home Counties.

Core services include:
- Property development and development strategy
- Residential and commercial construction
- Design and build delivery
- Basement construction, extensions and loft conversions
- Commercial refurbishment and mixed-use development
- MEP, electrical, HVAC, security, data and smart building systems
- Planned maintenance, reactive maintenance and lifecycle property support
